title: Likely Is Not Certain — Probability Models
note: Bag diagrams reveal contents to explain the model; use an opaque bag for actual draws. Detached counters in outlined bubbles represent target events, not extra bag contents or guaranteed results. Example sequences are possible outcomes, not predicted schedules. Blue and red counters have equal size and shape; colors are also named in native activity text.
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
style: Text-free cartoons and mathematically exact diagrams

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Square text-free 2D cartoon classroom illustration, clean outlines, flat colors, minimal shading, uncluttered composition. Students are age appropriate with clearly cartoon faces and hands, never photorealistic. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, number scales, charts or mathematical symbols. Two thirteen-year-old cartoon students compare their observations at an accessible table: pale auburn-haired child with glasses using a manual wheelchair, and brown-skinned child with curly hair. Blank notebook, pencil and closed opaque bag only. Both are engaged. No charts, counters or writing. Anatomical clarity: exactly two arms per student. The curly-haired student has both hands lying flat on the tabletop, clearly separated. Neither hand touches the face and neither hand points. The wheelchair user holds the closed bag with exactly two hands.
assets.caption: Record every trial, including results that differ from your prediction.
assets.alt: A cartoon student using a wheelchair holds an opaque bag while a brown-skinned classmate rests both hands on the table beside a notebook.

assets.prompt: Exact diagram specification: Twenty pictured trial results containing exactly seven red and thirteen blue
assets.caption: An example record has 7 red results in 20 trials: relative frequency 7/20 = 0.35.
assets.alt: Twenty counters form four rows of five. Seven are red and thirteen are blue; these depict a sample record.

assets.prompt: Exact diagram specification: Four same-sized counters beside two mismatched-size counters in a separate outlined panel
assets.caption: Unequal sizes may undermine the assumption that all counters have equal chances.
assets.alt: A group of four equal-sized counters contrasts with a separate pair containing one large blue and one small red counter.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Square text-free 2D cartoon classroom illustration, clean outlines, flat colors, minimal shading, uncluttered composition.
